about_the_game:
The official soundtrack from Phijkchu Quest, a game you should definitely play.
Features all 41 tracks from the game, 2 cut tracks, plus several bonus soundtrack exclusive items!
Includes the official Phijkchu Quest Artbook (Censored Edition)

Available as MP3.
